reading_source: Page 1: every phrase reviewed against supplied Japanese and context. 本当 ほんとう, 確かに たしかに, 面白い おもしろい, 意外 いがい. へえ is lexical interjection hee, not directional へ. No particles need conversion on this page. Natural connected short reactions; question/acknowledgement contours distinguished. Exact kanjium sense-matched targets and component references retained. Page 2: heading 理解できたとき → りかいできたとき; 仕組み → しくみ, 意味 → いみ, やっと gemination, そういう long-vowel sequence checked in the realization context. No particle conversions needed. Supplied commas after complete なるほど and ああ expressions kept; no breaks inside そういう or before なんですね. Phrase pitch remains provisional under standing authorization. Page 3: each supplied phrase reviewed for context: 知りません しりません; 初めて はじめて; 聞きました ききました; 見ました みました; 気になって きになって; 気づきました きづきました; 全然 ぜんぜん; 考えた かんがえた; なかった doubled t. Lexical は in はじめて preserved; no topic は or object を occurs in these phrases. Commas after それ stay after the complete topic expression; no added internal pauses. Whole-phrase pitch provisional under standing authorization. Page 4: 勘違い かんちがい, 逆 ぎゃく, 思って おもって, 意味 いみ, 違う ちがう checked in misunderstanding context. Exact lexical accent component targets retained. Template 〜 is not spoken; recording uses reviewed example そうだとおもってました while display remains unchanged. Supplied commas after complete interjections retained; no pauses inside predicate or before particles. Page 5: 意味 いみ, 確認 かくにん, 合って あって, 感じ かんじ checked in clarification context. Heading object を → お. Template audio substitutions reviewed: 明日 あした (tomorrow), 同じ おなじ (same), これ. No spoken placeholder marks. Keep ってこと/って意味 and こういう continuous, with no pause before question endings; comma after complete つまり only. Whole-phrase pitch provisional under standing authorization. Page 6: 一度 いちど vs 一回 いっかい; 聞き取れません ききとれません, 最後 さいご, 少し すこし, 意味 いみ, 例えば たとえば reviewed in requests. Template uses だしってなんですか (What is dashi?). No particles need conversion. Keep どういう connected; commas only after complete すみません and 最後のところ expressions. Checked lexical accent targets retained; unconfirmed phrase intonation provisional under standing authorization. Page 7: 言葉 ことば, 意味 いみ, 難しい むずかしい reviewed in partial-understanding context. Topic は → わ in heading 言葉は, sentence 言葉は and 意味は only. Gemination in ちょっと/わかって retained. Supplied comma follows complete clause わかるんですけど; brief trailing unfinished phrase, no pauses before particles. Exact lexical component pitch sources retained; full-phrase pitch provisional under standing authorization. Page 8: readings reviewed: 待って まって, 言えば いえば, 言う いう, 日本語 にほんご, 考えます かんがえます, 言葉 ことば, 出て でて, 思い出しました おもいだしました. Heading 時間を → じかんお. Gemination retained in ちょっと/まって/えっと/でしたっけ. Short natural hesitations, no exaggerated vowel stretching or syllable gaps; comma after complete あ interjection. Lexical component pitch targets retained, whole-phrase intonation provisional under standing authorization. Page 9: 話 はなし, 続けて つづけて, 何か なにか, 理由 りゆう, 日本 にほん, 普通 ふつう, 他 ほか, 例えば たとえば reviewed in follow-up-question context. Heading object を → お, 日本では → にほんでわ; lexical は in はなし preserved. Long vowels in どう/りゆう/ふつう and gemination in なった/それって retained. Keep でわ continuous, no pauses before particles. Lexical component targets sourced, whole-phrase intonation provisional under standing authorization. Page 10: 覚えて おぼえて, 今度 こんど, 参考 さんこう, 勉強 べんきょう, 聞いて きいて, 使えそう つかえそう reviewed in learning/usefulness context. Normal long vowels in さんこう/べんきょう/きいて/そう and doubled consonants in やって/よかった preserved. No particle conversions needed. Supplied commas after complete それ expressions retained, no internal predicate pauses. Exact lexical component targets retained; whole-phrase pitch provisional under standing authorization. Page 11: 意見 いけん, 言う いう, 多分 たぶん (adverb), 思います おもいます, 確かに たしかに, 私 わたし, 違う ちがう, 気 き reviewed for uncertainty/soft disagreement. Heading を → お; 私は → わたしわ only. Long vowels in そう/どう/でしょう and gemination in ちょっと preserved. Comma after complete まあ interjection; no pauses before particles or inside predicates. Sourced sense-specific lexical component pitch targets retained; whole-phrase pitch provisional under standing authorization. Page 12: 残念 ざんねん, 大変 たいへん, 羨ましい うらやましい, 怖い こわい, 楽しそう たのしそう, 難しそう むずかしそう, 便利 べんり, 不思議 ふしぎ checked in emotional response context. Appearance forms retain そう, not original adjective い. Heading object を → お. Gemination in よかった/もったいない and long vowels in うらやましい/そう preserved. No internal pauses or exaggerated emotional stretching. Exact lexical targets retained; whole-phrase and unsourced appearance-form pitch provisional under standing authorization. Page 13: 短く みじかく, 便利 べんり, 返事 へんじ, 確かに たしかに reviewed in short casual reaction context. Lexical へ in へんじ preserved; no particle conversions needed. Gemination in そっか and normal long vowels in そう preserved. Initial あ is brief; tiny comma pause follows the complete interjection, no pause before ね or inside そういう. Sourced component accent targets retained; full reaction intonation provisional under standing authorization. Page 14: supplied readings checked in context: 何 なに, 合わせる あわせる, 人 ひと. Polite によりますね vs casual によるね retained. No topic/directional/object particles requiring respelling. Complete embedded question clauses remain connected to による; no commas needed. Whole phrase intonation provisional under standing authorization.
notes: All 13 pages reviewed and generated page by page. Whole-phrase intonation provisional where reliable targets unavailable. No listening verification claimed.
